prompt:
## Objective
Make the resolved model visible in run logs. Today logs show only adapter=pi provider_ref=<opaque>; operators cannot tell which of the ordered candidates ran or whether fallback occurred.

## Design summary
- In elixir/lib/rondo/model_routing.ex resolve/1 (L32-45): after `resolved = List.first(candidates)`, emit a structured Logger.info containing adapter, resolved provider/model string, effective tier, candidate index (0-based) and fallback? flag, plus issue/request identifier and turn/stage when available in opts. When filter_openrouter_candidates drops candidates or a later candidate is selected after a failure, log both the failed candidate and the selected fallback.
- In elixir/lib/rondo/agent_runner.ex (L1031-1034): extend the "Completed agent turn" Logger.info with the resolved model string (thread it via turn_context; keep the change minimal and local to logging).
- Cover manifest run-once flows, not only tracker-driven flows - the resolution path is shared, assert via tests on resolve/1 output and log capture.
- Ticket acceptance criteria are the spec; implement them verbatim.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/model_routing.ex, elixir/lib/rondo/agent_runner.ex (logging call sites and turn_context plumbing only), elixir/test/rondo/model_routing_test.exs. Exclude: any routing behavior change - selection order and filtering must be byte-identical.

## Constraints
Logging only; zero behavior change to candidate selection. No remote writes.

## Verification
cd elixir && mix test test/rondo/model_routing_test.exs
cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted && mix credo --strict && mix test
dependencies: mix resolves only via mise PATH (probed: not on default PATH; found at $HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/elixir/1.19.5-otp-28/bin/mix; prepend that dir plus $HOME/.local/share/mise/installs/erlang/28.5/bin to PATH)
model_routing.ex resolve/1 at L32-45 (candidates_for_hint, filter_openrouter_candidates, List.first) verified
agent_runner.ex 'Completed agent turn' Logger.info at L1031-1034 verified
proof_requirements: ron-163-log-resolved-model-candidate-gates: Rondo Elixir gates (format, credo, test, pre-PR dialyzer).

ron-163-log-resolved-model-candidate-gates success: cd elixir && mix credo --strict exits 0
ron-163-log-resolved-model-candidate-gates success: cd elixir && mix test exits 0
ron-163-log-resolved-model-candidate-gates success: cd elixir && mix dialyzer --format short exits 0

output_expectations.summary: Run logs answer 'which model actually ran': resolve/1 emits adapter, provider/model, tier, candidate index and fallback flag with issue/turn context; the Completed-agent-turn line includes the resolved model; fallbacks log failed candidate plus selected fallback.
